blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Senator-judges on Monday questioned defense witness Davao City Assessor Engr. Jaime Adalin’s trip to China along with other local government officials. Adalin’s overseas travel came to light when, during the cross-examination, private prosecutor Benjamin Tolosa Jr. asked whether or not back in November 2025 Davao City LGU officials, had a supposed all-expense-paid trip to China on the money of the Chinese consulate. Initially, Adalin stated he could not recall the dates of a trip to China, but during Senator-judge Raffy Tulfo’s interjection, the engineer confirmed the trip abroad on January 25, 2026.
